Plugins_Desc: Add-ons that extend Downloader (e.g. HLS stream downloads). The core app stays lightweight; install only what you need.
Plugins_NoneFound: That file doesn't contain a Downloader plugin. Make sure it's a plugin (.dll) built for this version.
Plugins_Empty_Hint: Click "Install Plugins" to add a plugin (.dll), or drop one into the plugins folder.
Empty_Hint: Paste a link in the box above and click Add to begin.
Plan_NoProcessor: No installed plugin can assemble this download — the required plugin may be disabled or missing.
Error_LinkExpired: This link looks expired or invalid — the server returned a web page instead of the file. Get a fresh link and try again.
Add_LinksPlaceholder: https://…  (paste multiple links, one per line, to download all into the folder below)
Add_ClipboardHint: Press Enter to use clipboard link
Add_FileNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to detect automatically from the link
Settings_ResetTip: Restore every setting to its default value
Set_RememberSavePath_Hint: When on, the folder you choose for a new download becomes the default save folder.
Set_Connections_Hint: How many parts a file is split into.
Set_Accent_Hint: Highlight color used across the app.
Set_Notifications_Hint: Master switch for the alerts below.
Shutdown_Message: All downloads have finished. Your computer will shut down automatically.
Shutdown_Notify_Msg: All downloads finished — the computer will shut down in {0}s. Open Downloader to cancel.
Set_NotifyShutdown_Hint: Shows a 30-second notice you can click to cancel the shutdown.
Set_ShutdownOnComplete: Shut down the computer when all downloads finish
Set_ShutdownOnComplete_Hint: Powers off 30 seconds after the last download completes (cancelable).
Set_BrowserIntegration_Hint: Lets the browser extension, scripts and the command line add and control downloads over a local-only connection (nothing is exposed to the network).
LocalApi_PortChangedMsg: Port 15151 was busy, so Downloader is now listening on 127.0.0.1:{0}. The browser extension will reconnect automatically.
Set_SystemTray: Keep running in the system tray
Set_SystemTray_Hint: Closing the window keeps downloads running in the background.
Set_RunAtStartup_Hint: Starts hidden in the tray when you sign in.
Set_AutoUpdate_Hint: Tells you when a new version is available on GitHub.
Update_Ready_Tip: A new version is ready — restart to install
Set_WriteLog_Hint: Records app and download-engine activity for diagnosing problems. Off by default.
Set_ClearOnFail: Clear package when a download fails
Net_Hint: Advanced HTTP options for tricky servers — usually safe to leave as-is.
About_Desc: Cross-platform download manager. No installation or dependencies required.
Det_Mirrors_Hint: Extra sources for the same file, used as fallbacks. Editable while the download is stopped.
Det_UseGlobalLimitTip: Follow the global speed limit from Settings instead of a per-item cap
Det_ConnAppear: Connections appear here while the file is downloading.
Queues_Desc: A queue groups downloads and limits how many run at the same time. Pause a whole queue, or set its limit.
Queues_ToggleTip: Pause or run this whole queue
Queues_DeleteTip: Delete queue (its downloads move to another queue)
Queues_RemoveConfirm: “{0}” still has {1} unfinished download(s). Remove the queue anyway? Its downloads move to the default queue.
Queues_Empty: No downloads in this queue yet.
Sched_Desc: Start and stop a queue automatically at set times.
Set_Notch_Hint: A small pill at the top-center of the screen showing the clock; hover it to see live download progress.
Plugins_MoreHint: Optional plugins you can add from the catalog
Donate_ThankYou: Downloader is free and open source, built in my spare time. If it saves you time, consider supporting it — thank you! 🙏
Donate_Sponsors_Hint: One-off or monthly, right on GitHub
Donate_Usdt_Warn: Double-check the network before sending — funds sent on the wrong network may be lost.
Donate_OtherWays: No money needed — starring the project, reporting bugs and translating help just as much.
State_RefreshingLink: Link expired — getting a fresh one…
Error_LinkExpiredRefresh: This link is no longer valid — it expired or was withdrawn. Open Details and paste a fresh link to continue without losing the downloaded part.
Error_BrowserHandoffRefused: Downloader couldn't fetch this link, so your browser is still downloading it — the file isn't lost. This usually means the site's link works only once.
Det_RefreshHint: Link expired? Paste a fresh one above and press Refresh link — the download continues from where it stopped.
Det_RefreshMismatchTitle: This link points to a different file
Det_RefreshMismatchBody: The new link reports {0}, but this download is {1}. Continuing discards what has been downloaded and starts over.
Error_SiteNeedsBrowserSession: This site only gives the video to a signed-in browser session. Send the page from the Downloader browser extension — it passes your existing session along with the link.
Error_ServerRefusedConnections: The server refused several connections at once. Lower “Maximum connections” in Settings (2 or 3 usually works) and try again.
Error_NothingDownloaded: The download finished without producing a file — the server accepted the request but sent no data. Try again, or add the link again if it keeps happening.
Error_DownloadStalled: The download stopped responding — the server accepted the connection but sent nothing for minutes. It was stopped so you can try again.
Ext_Install_Hint: Find your browsers and add the extension
Ext_NotDetected: Not found here — you can still install it
Ext_FilesUpToDate: These files are up to date
Ext_FilesOutdated: Out of date — v{0} is available
Ext_ReloadAfterUpdate: The files are updated. Your browser still has the old copy loaded: open its extensions page and press Reload (or restart the browser) to pick up the new version.
Ext_Steps_Chromium_1: Open a new tab and go to chrome://extensions
Ext_Steps_Chromium_2: Turn on “Developer mode” in the top right
Ext_Steps_Chromium_3: Click “Load unpacked” and pick the folder below
Ext_Steps_Gecko_1: Open a new tab and go to about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox
Ext_Steps_Gecko_3: Pick the manifest.json inside the folder below
Ext_Limits_Chromium: Added this way, the browser shows a developer-mode notice each time it starts, and the extension will not update itself. Keep this folder where it is — moving or deleting it removes the extension.
Ext_Limits_Gecko: Firefox removes an add-on added this way when the browser restarts, so you would need to add it again each time. Use the Firefox Add-ons listing when it is available.
Ext_NoBrowsers: No supported browser was found on this computer.
Ext_NoBuild: Could not reach the download for the extension. Check your connection and try again.
Err_OpenFolder_NoPath: This download has no folder saved.
Ext_UsingBundled: Using the copy included with the app. It will update from the next release.
